name: flame.filewatch/configure.v1
description: Replace or rearm the trigger at its current revision; omitting trigger disables observation. Configuration acceptance does not claim a live watch. Captured work remains immutable.

name: flame.filewatch/event.v1
description: Read one retained observation and its complete original dispatch capture.

name: flame.filewatch/events.v1
description: Read at most 256 retained observation headers, newest first. Accepted means core confirmed the captured Run opening, not that execution completed. Pending intents are never pruned.

name: flame.filewatch/get.v1
description: Read this installation's single persistent file trigger and configuration revision.

name: flame.filewatch/status.v1
description: Inspect the actual background observation revision and failures. A failed watch requires explicit configuration rearm; accepted dispatch intents continue reconciliation.
